title: Strict version advancement
spec: Implement advance(state, version, value). state is a dictionary with integer version, value and writes. Apply the update only when version is strictly greater than state[version]; then increment writes by one and return True. Equal or older versions return False and must leave the entire state unchanged.
target_defect: Equal versions are reapplied, changing value and incrementing writes.
author_rationale: The change groups state replacement and write accounting behind a version check.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
